citations.line: *Linnaeus*. Hold that, in a book of genealogy: the cup
Linnaeus named an ugly weed after him. And in 1753
He said of himself, *God created, Linnaeus ordered*. The load
Of Linnaeus. The son, Emanuel, born in Stockholm in 1688,
In the cathedral, near Linnaeus's. The farthest
Of a Swedish parson, Daniel Solander, one of Linnaeus's apostles, to bear
Of the patronymic turning each generation, as in Sweden, as Linnaeus's father had done
